name: talk2myagent
description: Local customer-support calling with a single Codex agent, open speech models, recording and transcripts.

interface.shortDescription: Call support from your Mac with local speech.
interface.longDescription: Prepare a precise call plan, dial through the Mac Phone app with computer use, listen and speak with local Whisper and Kokoro, then return the transcript and recording.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use phone-call to prepare and rehearse an Amazon return call.
